review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Role Summary We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) to design, build, migrate, and operate enterprise-grade cloud environments. Execute migration strategies (Rehost, Re-platform, Refactor) aligned with business and technical requirements. Collaborate with solution architects, application teams, and client stakeholders to translate requirements into OCI designs. Required Skills & Experience 7 - 8 years of progressive experience in cloud engineering with a minimum of 4 years focused on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Strong hands-on expertise with OCI core services: Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM, Database, and Security. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform with OCI provider is mandatory).
